title: Test phase-accumulator closure and its recursive width cost
body:
A scalar phase accumulator appears to offer a cheap stateful recursive boundary, but reusing one bank across independent tensor columns creates cross terms. This package gives the explicit failure, two correct bank-return contracts (including reverse-order consumers on a shared bank), and an actual C/Q recursion checked through two levels. Its optimistic child-width moment is critical, so this construction round stops without a new kappa or supplier claim.

The reusable contribution is the paired tensor/shared-bank experiment and its complete finite execution records. It includes the standard scoped Pauli bank-dimension argument, an elementary support gate for direct C/monomial products, a stronger two-C comparator and a one-wide-C comparator, with all operand volume retained. The bounds do not exclude arbitrary encoded supplier interfaces or different paid mixing primitives. Written next questions identify those exact missing contracts.

Validation: the registered CPython 3.12 replay passed under `-I -O -B`: 23 full-column fixtures (including all 512 columns of the two-level map and its literal inverse, plus a nested live-bank map checked at its open and returned boundaries), a separate Fraction/Walsh implementation, invoice recounts, ten semantic/cost controls, and relocation/read-only/corruption tests. The separate implementation has the same AI-assisted author; no independent human review or full selected cold replay is claimed. Native controller, hosting and analytic costs remain explicit obligations, not free resources.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/phase-accumulator-tensor-closure
```

Donor-assigned exploration, up to 300 minutes; one bounded pivot and early stopping on the failed budget. Original scientific provenance: `23ef28cbeb7a3e2e985be22cab6832424bd98cf6`. Validation on canonical `1fb5ac85b019b58a53e18baa8629137beb90dd57` preserves the kernel input and revision-5 guidance; that upstream checkpoint also fixes the pre-existing selected-supplement digest mismatch noted at entry. The published package-only branch starts from the fork’s existing ancestor `c0e3631dc24e3c24a861f7d3d79e0608481cccec` because GitHub rejected pushing inherited workflow updates with the current OAuth scope. Its package tree is byte-identical to the tested canonical-based commit; the PR diff contains only this new package. Submission overlap covers 600 open PRs and 1,491 Discussion/comment/reply records, complete pagination at 02:28–02:30 UTC, plus local/current-upstream notes. It is not a novelty proof.

Coordination and handoff: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2842. Prior Pauli/Clifford/FFT methods, cyclic-state research, native-reader work and selected-child caller work retain attribution in the README. Prepared for Gareth Davidson (@bitplane), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. New files are Apache-2.0; no frozen package or selected result is changed by this contribution.
